evals.prompt: Add a shadcn dialog to this existing project. components.json and package files are present, but no project summary has been supplied.
evals.expected_output: The agent acquires project context before choosing paths, imports, icons, or component props, then reports evidence or a bounded blocked state.
expectations: Runs shadcn info --json from the project root or inspects components.json and installed source when the command fails
Does not claim that project context was automatically injected
Does not invent aliases, icon packages, resolved paths, or installed components
Fetches current dialog docs or inspects installed dialog source before choosing exact props
Names project checks and interaction evidence required before reporting working UI

evals.prompt: Add the official shadcn button and dialog components to an initialized project, preserving any existing local component changes.
evals.expected_output: A safe standard add workflow that previews affected files, avoids unnecessary registry questions, preserves local source, and verifies the project.
expectations: Treats unqualified official component names as unambiguous
Checks installed components before adding them
Uses add --dry-run or --diff before replacing installed files
Does not use --overwrite without explicit approval
Inspects emitted source and runs relevant project checks

evals.prompt: Apply preset code a2r6bw to this existing shadcn project, but keep my customized components intact and only change the theme if the CLI supports it.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects current and incoming preset state, uses current preset/apply commands, scopes the operation to supported parts, and does not replace components.
expectations: Uses preset resolve and preset decode or equivalent current CLI commands
Checks apply --help before relying on partial-apply flags
Uses apply rather than forced reinitialization for the existing project
Does not replace customized component source
Reports files changed and project or visual checks performed

evals.prompt: Build a settings form with name and email fields, independent email/SMS/push notification switches, and a searchable input with an embedded submit action.
evals.expected_output: A current shadcn form composition using Field semantics, independent Switch controls, and InputGroupButton inside InputGroupAddon.
expectations: Uses Field and FieldGroup for labelled controls
Uses Switch for each independent notification setting rather than a single-choice ToggleGroup
Uses InputGroupInput and InputGroupButton instead of plain Input and Button inside InputGroup
Pairs data-invalid on Field with aria-invalid on the control
Requires typecheck and behavior checks rather than accepting JSX shape alone

evals.prompt: Redesign the entire product so it feels premium, define a new visual hierarchy and motion language, then audit the finished experience for accessibility.
evals.expected_output: A clear handoff: frontend-design owns visual direction and web-ui-reviewer owns the formal accessibility verdict; shadcn remains scoped to component implementation guidance.
expectations: Does not claim ownership of product-wide art direction
Routes visual hierarchy and motion decisions to frontend-design
Routes the formal accessibility verdict to web-ui-reviewer
States the shadcn-specific implementation contribution it can provide
Does not claim completion from component scaffolding alone
